_comment: MAKING IS THE KIT -- the instrument that opens the Craft page, the way the notebook opens writing a thought down. Mr Richards' own, lent rather than given: it is the first thing anyone trusts the boy with. A key item, so it can never be thrown into the pot it makes possible.
name: Mr Richards' Kit
description: A canvas roll of tools worn smooth at the handles. Someone has used these for forty years and kept them sharp.
